title: An international consulting hub for entering the markets of Belarus and the EAEU
lead: We help Italian businesses understand markets, find partners and assess risks — before making a decision.

mission.title: Why VIKUB
mission.text: VIKUB is not an acronym. It is our names and our lives: we are a family, an Italian and a Belarusian, living in both countries. We do not study markets only through reports — we work in them every day.

people.name: Mario Ubaldi
people.about: For 30 years, we have helped companies grow through financing, grants and internationalisation. Languages: Italian, English, French and Portuguese.

people.name: Viktoryia Hubanava
people.about: For 17 years, I have built partnerships between Europe and Belarus. Trade fairs, business missions and negotiations with embassies and public authorities. Russian, English; currently learning Italian.

people.name: Olga Skrebnevskaya
people.about: 20 years of experience. Specialises in consecutive interpreting and legal and business communication. Has worked with the Embassy of Italy in Belarus and dozens of Italian delegations.

status.title: Official status
status.text: Official representative of the National Agency of Investment and Privatization of the Republic of Belarus (NAIP) in Italy.
items: direct access to Belarusian businesses and their actual needs
information on incentives and government support measures
the ability to arrange meetings with government bodies

items.title: Official status
items.text: NAIP representatives in Italy, with direct access to government support.

items.title: Three languages
items.text: We work in Russian, Italian and English.

items.title: Two markets, one team
items.text: We live and work in Italy and Belarus, and understand both sides.

items.title: End-to-end support
items.text: From market research to supplying retail chains, with a single team.

items.title: Checks before introductions
items.text: We check counterparties for reliability and sanctions risks before you invest time in a meeting.

items.title: A network of vetted specialists
items.text: Accountants, interpreters and other specialists are available on request.

seo.title: About us — VIKUB
seo.description: We build practical bridges between Italian manufacturers and Belarusian markets. Official status, an international team and real experience.

experts.title: Trusted experts — for your task
experts.text: We do not keep lawyers and accountants on staff, but have a network of reliable specialists whom we bring in as needed. You pay only for what you actually use.
